web.disclosure: This preview uses local test services instead of live AI services. No data is sent to live AI providers. When live generation becomes available, your descriptions, lyrics and gift details will be sent to the chosen lyric-writing and safety provider, which is still to be selected. Music descriptions and lyrics will go to Google Lyria or ElevenLabs Music, depending on the model you choose. Cover descriptions will go to the chosen image provider. We will name all providers and update this notice before live use.
